categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the semiconductor materials sector, focusing on large-diameter silicon materials, silicon components, and large-size semiconductor silicon wafers. These products are used mainly in integrated circuit etching equipment and semiconductor manufacturing. The business segments include the production and sales of large-diameter silicon materials, silicon parts for plasma etching machines, and high-end semiconductor wafers, with ongoing development in customized silicon components and advanced wafer technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced crystal growth technologies such as the Czochralski method for single crystal silicon production without magnetic fields, solid-liquid interface control, and optimized thermal field design. It has developed proprietary technologies for multi-crystalline silicon densification, precision etching and cleaning of silicon components, ultra-flat wafer polishing, and defect density control. Manufacturing processes include precise machining, chemical mechanical polishing, and high-temperature argon annealing, supported by digital process control and quality management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor silicon component manufacturers in Japan, South Korea, and China, plasma etching equipment manufacturers, and integrated circuit fabs such as Samsung, SK Hynix, Intel, and domestic Chinese foundries like Yangtze Memory Technologies. The company serves the semiconductor manufacturing industry, particularly focusing on suppliers of etching equipment components and wafer materials for advanced logic and memory chips.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production facilities in Jinzhou and Quanzhou, and has significant sales to international markets including Japan, South Korea, and the United States. It maintains a global supply chain presence, supplying silicon materials to overseas component manufacturers and equipment suppliers, while expanding its domestic market share in China’s growing semiconductor industry.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain, producing raw and processed silicon materials and components that are critical inputs for semiconductor etching equipment manufacturers and integrated circuit fabs. It supplies large-diameter silicon crystals and precision silicon parts used in plasma etching machines, positioning itself as a key materials supplier to midstream equipment manufacturers and downstream semiconductor fabricators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for large-diameter silicon materials and silicon components, advancing R&D in high-end semiconductor wafers such as 8-inch lightly doped low-defect polished wafers, and developing customized silicon parts for plasma etching equipment. The company emphasizes innovation in crystal growth, defect control, surface processing, and cleaning technologies to meet evolving customer requirements and to support domestic semiconductor supply chain security. It also focuses on talent acquisition and strengthening its technical team.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor-grade silicon materials, silicon components, and large-size silicon wafers to equipment manufacturers and integrated circuit fabs. The company follows a customer order plus self-stock production model, with sales mainly conducted via large customer direct sales. Revenue depends on product shipments upon customer acceptance and contract fulfillment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the global large-diameter silicon materials market, competing with established international suppliers such as Mitsubishi Materials and SK Chemicals. It is recognized for its technological capabilities and scale in producing 14-22 inch silicon crystals and related components. The company is also among the few domestic Chinese firms with integrated capabilities from crystal growth to finished silicon parts, positioning it strongly in the domestic market amid increasing localization trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 135 million, a 75% decline year-over-year due to semiconductor industry downturn and reduced downstream demand. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 69 million. Despite the downturn, the company expanded capacity, increased R&D investment (16.64% of revenue), and maintained a net asset base of RMB 1.76 billion, reflecting ongoing growth and investment in production capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced crystal growth technologies that enable large-diameter, high-purity silicon materials with high yield and parameter consistency without relying on magnetic fields, reducing costs. Its integrated manufacturing capability from raw silicon to precision silicon components for plasma etching machines offers customers stable, high-quality supply and customization. The firm’s focus on domestic supply chain security and ability to meet stringent technical requirements differentiates it in the Chinese semiconductor materials market.
